data: In fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023), Apple reported net sales of $383,285 million, gross profit (reported as "gross margin") of $169,148 million, and operating income of $114,301 million, according to its Form 10-K filed November 3, 2023. That works out to a gross margin of about 44.1% and an operating margin of about 29.8%. For comparison, in fiscal 2022 revenue was $394,328 million, gross profit was $170,782 million (about 43.3%), and operating income was $119,437 million (about 30.3%). So in fiscal 2023 gross margin expanded slightly even as revenue fell about 2.8%, while operating margin narrowed as research and development spending rose to $29,915 million.
